purpose: One row of the /blog listing: image left, copy right.
geometry: wrapper w-[95.2213em] (1015.69px), margin 53.3333px 0 101.3333px; card 1015.69x430.66 overflow-hidden; image column h-[40em] w-1/2 flex-1 -> 505.84x426.66 with a 2px right border; copy column w-1/2 p-[4em]
maxWordsBasis: recomputed over all 53 real blogPosts entries
excerptCorrection: CLONE_SPEC_CONTENT_A §1.5 records card excerpts as '2–4 lines'. FOUR LINES BREAKS THE CONSTANT CARD HEIGHT: it pushes the copy past the 426.66px image column. Real excerpts are 2–3 lines and the pitch is a constant 531.98px.
states: No hover, no active, no focus, no transition, no box-shadow. Measured transform:none and cursor:auto.
negatives: ONLY 'Keep reading' is a link — the image and the h2 are NOT wrapped in an anchor; do not make the whole card clickable
`--blog-card-tablet-width` is referenced by the original but never defined in its own stylesheet, so the <=991px card is plain w-full
leaves: 3 CARD_LEAVES per row (159 across the 53 rows), initial state only
